answer: A stake-bonded registry resists Sybil attacks by making each identity expensive: an agent must lock funds that are slashed if caught running duplicate identities, so a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand stakes. Like a cedar that takes years to reach the summit, reputation accrues slowly through attested work, so a fresh identity cannot outvote elders; one fake vote sends a ripple through the slashing pool, burning the attacker bond instead of just one account.
